input.quote: Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 11.1 provides automatic renewals of twelve months only (not multi-year) with a mutual non-renewal notice window of just 30 days, which sits at the preferred position on both renewal term length and exit notice (well inside the fallback ceiling of 60 days and far from the 90-day walk-away). Exhibit B fixes MarketSite.net and maintenance/support fees for "Year 2-5, and beyond," so there is no renewal price-uplift mechanic to cap. The absence of a vendor reminder 60 days before renewal and of an express CPI/3% uplift cap are minor sub-elements short of the preferred wording and are noted rather than redlined; the five-year initial term is an initial commitment, not an automatic multi-year renewal, and is addressed under term-length rules if at all.
